transcript: This time, tomorrow, I will be sitting in a meeting room at ten I will be attending a lecture, and in the afternoon I will be finishing the new project file I have waited a long time for this appointment For more than a month, I have been making steady progress On the same day, my colleague will also be engaged in another task After lunch, I will probably move on to the afternoon meeting By evening, I will nearly complete the report Sometimes I wonder where I will be a year from now Three years? Life will continue, and I too will be living through many more days Placing myself within a schedule gives the day a gentle momentum This time, tomorrow, I will most likely be sitting at my desk But beyond that single moment, another tomorrow is already waiting quietly Thank you.
